beats.summary: Josh declines the new position at Dunder-Mifflin and accepts a senior management role at Staples.

evidence.snippet: Josh: As of today, I have accepted a senior managment position at Staples.
Jan: Damn it, Josh. This whole restructuring thing was based around keeping you.

beats.summary: Jan announces that Scranton will absorb Stamford and offers Jim the number two position at Scranton.

evidence.snippet: Jan: And I know that you just left there a couple of months ago, but we would like to offer you the number two position at that branch.

beats.summary: Jan reveals to the Scranton staff that their branch is not closing, but Stamford is.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: We know the branch is closing; Michael told us.

beats.summary: Ryan and Kelly acknowledge their breakup is likely, but are happy the branch closing is not happening.
